$$S(c)=\{x\in\mathbb R: f(x)=c\}$$
and $|S(c)|$ denote the number of elements in $S(c)$. Then, the value of
$$|S(-7)|+|S(-5)|+|S(3)|$$
equals ______

iitjam-2024-57.prompt:
Let $c>0$ be such that
$$\int_0^ce^{s^2}\,ds=3.$$
Then, the value of
$$\int_0^c\left(\int_x^ce^{x^2+y^2}\,dy\right)dx$$
equals ______ (rounded off to one decimal place).

iitjam-2024-58.prompt:
For $k\in\mathbb N$, let $0=t_0<t_1<\cdots<t_k<t_{k+1}=1$. A function $f:[0,1]\to\mathbb R$ is said to be piecewise linear with nodes $t_1,\dots,t_k$, if for each $j=1,2,\dots,k+1$, there exist $a_j\in\mathbb R$, $b_j\in\mathbb R$ such that
$$f(t)=a_j+b_jt\quad\text{for } t_{j-1}<t<t_j.$$
Let $V$ be the real vector space of all real valued continuous piecewise linear functions on $[0,1]$ with nodes $\frac14,\frac12,\frac34$. Then, the dimension of $V$ equals ______

iitjam-2024-59.prompt:
For $n\in\mathbb N$, let
$$a_n=\frac{1}{n^{n-1}}\sum_{k=0}^n\frac{n!}{k!\,(n-k)!}\,\frac{n^k}{k+1}$$
and $\beta=\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n$. Then, the value of $\log\beta$ equals ______ (rounded off to two decimal places).

iitjam-2024-60.prompt:
Define the function $f:(-1,1)\to\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right)$ by
$$f(x)=\sin^{-1}x.$$
Let $a_6$ denote the coefficient of $x^6$ in the Taylor series of $(f(x))^2$ about $x=0$. Then, the value of $9a_6$ equals ______ (rounded off to two decimal places).
